basic_profile.bio: Originally from Washington, now living in sunny Florida. I'm an avid angler with a passion for exploring new fishing spots. I enjoy a good cup of coffee and discussing the latest trends in the stock market. In my spare time, I tinker with dual-core processors and write poetry. Married to my high school sweetheart, and we have two cats. I work remotely as a software developer, which gives me the flexibility to fish during off-peak hours. Typically online late at night and early mornings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My fishing knowledge is mostly self-taught, with a lot of insights gained from local communities and online forums. I also have a keen interest in the stock market, which I follow closely.
